instruction: Contrast the features of iPad Pro 12.9-inch models from the 4th, 5th, and 6th generations.

metadata.explanation: This variation maintains the same task pattern as the original iPhone comparison but focuses on iPad Pro models instead. The task requires the agent to navigate Apple's website and use their comparison tool to compare three generations of iPad Pro 12.9-inch models. The evaluator uses the same existing functions (get_active_tab_url_parse and check_direct_json_object) to parse the comparison URL and verify that all three iPad Pro models are present in the modelList query parameter. The difficulty and interaction pattern remain identical to the original task.
metadata.verification_notes: Reuses existing getter (get_active_tab_url_parse) and metric (check_direct_json_object) functions. No custom functions needed. The expected model identifiers follow Apple's URL naming convention for iPad Pro models.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is semantically correct: get_active_tab_url_parse extracts the modelList query parameter from the active tab URL and splits comma-separated values into a list
Metric comparison logic is correct: check_direct_json_object compares the result with expected values and handles ignore_list_order flag properly to allow order-insensitive list matching
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts {modelList: [model1, model2, model3]} from URL query params, metric compares with expected list using sorted comparison when ignore_list_order=true

Expected values are semantically correct: The three iPad Pro model identifiers (ipad-pro-12-9-6th-generation, ipad-pro-12-9-5th-generation, ipad-pro-12-9-4th-generation) follow Apple's URL naming convention
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies that all three required iPad Pro models are present in the comparison URL, matching the instruction requirement exactly
The ignore_list_order flag correctly allows the models to be in any order in the URL, which is appropriate since the instruction doesn't specify order
